goal: Consolidate real DesignFlow mirror notifications into one canonical completion dispatch while preserving all per-head production checks and staged fallback
assumptions: Owner in this chat explicitly authorizes dependency-lock fixes then sync notification consolidation. This maintenance authors no SQL, app merge or production setting change.
Existing production reader, catalog/source/attestation, target, pending/failure/success semantics, designated App, locks and fallback remain untouched. No reviewer repair or invocation.

Additive central completion notification first, regardless partial mirror failure, assesses actual current heads. Consumer mirror-only push filtering is published only after the central completion dispatch is proved. Real/mixed app changes and relevant PR events keep notifying.
All old signatures, parked source and unrestricted sandbox/develop branches are preserved. No new scheduler, receiver, credential or SQL executor.
prohibited_actions: No SQL/database writes or production application/configuration mutation.
No status copying, pending suppression, weakened source/catalog proof, reviewer/toolkit repair, foreign evidence edits or app self-merge.
stop_conditions: Stop for a prospective scope amendment before any needed path outside this list.
Stop before consumer cutover if central completion dispatch is not genuinely proved.
